name: Cardiology
short: Consultation and ongoing care for conditions affecting the heart and blood vessels.
intro: The cardiology team sees patients for heart and circulation concerns, from first consultations to long-term follow-up. Care is planned together with you and, where needed, with other departments.
areas: Ongoing care after a cardiac event

name: Orthopaedics
short: Care for bones, joints, muscles and ligaments, from injuries to long-standing pain.
intro: Orthopaedics looks after the musculoskeletal system. Consultants assess injuries and joint problems and talk you through the options, including physiotherapy and surgical opinions where appropriate.

name: Neurology
short: Specialist assessment for conditions of the brain, spine and nervous system.
intro: Neurology consultants assess symptoms that may involve the brain, spinal cord or nerves, and coordinate any tests that are needed before agreeing a plan of care with you.

name: General Medicine
short: A first point of contact for adult health concerns, check-ups and long-term conditions.
intro: General Medicine is often the best place to begin when you are unsure where to go. Physicians assess a wide range of adult health concerns and refer you on to a specialist when it is needed.

name: Paediatrics
short: Gentle, family-centred care for infants, children and adolescents.
intro: The paediatrics team cares for children from birth through adolescence, with time set aside for parents' questions and a calm approach for young patients.

name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
short: Women's health at every stage of life, including pregnancy care.
intro: Obstetrics and Gynaecology supports women's health across life stages, offering private, respectful consultations and antenatal care planned around each patient.

name: Dermatology
short: Assessment and care for skin, hair and nail conditions for all ages.
intro: Dermatology consultants assess skin, hair and nail concerns, explain what they find in plain language and agree a treatment plan with you.
areas: Changes in moles or skin lesions

name: Gastroenterology
short: Care for the digestive system, including the stomach, intestines and liver.
intro: Gastroenterology looks after the digestive tract and liver. Consultants assess symptoms, arrange any investigations that are needed and explain each step before it happens.
